title: oxybaphus rotundifolius
intro: Oxybaphus rotundifolius, commonly known as Desert Trumpet, is a plant species native to North America, known for its bright orange to red trumpet-shaped flowers. The plant is used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and sore throat. The therapeutic actions of Oxybaphus rotundifolius include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
